- Keep the can bottom and fingertips above the basket rim and black handles while crossing. Lower the release height appropriately within an unobstructed opening while preserving finger withdrawal clearance to reduce collisions, bouncing or catching on handles.
- Apply lifting force smoothly and keep the basket opening upward. If the grasp slips or the basket tilts noticeably, restore bottom support on the table before adjusting, avoiding release in midair that could tip the basket or drop the can.
